ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem statement: In triangle ABC, A=30°, C=105°, b=4. According to the conventional definition of a triangle, sides a, b, c correspond to angles A, B, C respectively. From the sum of interior angles, B=180°-30°-105°=45°. According to the sine rule a/sin A=b/sin B, so a=4·sin30°/sin45°=4·(1/2)/(√2/2)=2√2.
